thread:
Maya: dropped a compact iteration for the keys page focusing on the one-time reveal and empty-state guidance. main asks: should the key panel be modal-blocking or anchored non-blocking? also how scary should the download reminder be? mock: https://design.redwood.local/mock/one-time-key-v1.png

Tom: my vote = anchored non-blocking panel but persistent until user explicitly acknowledges. users close drawers by accident; a modal feels heavy for a simple copy/download.

Jin: +1 anchored but make it obvious. big yellow callout with heading 'Save this key now' + primary 'Download key' + secondary 'I saved it'. put the key in a readonly textarea with a visible Copy button.

Priya: accessibility note: move keyboard focus to the textarea on reveal. textarea should have aria-label: "New API key value, copyable". Copy action must set aria-live polite with "Copied to clipboard". Also ensure ESC returns focus to the Create button.

Maya: copy ideas for callout: heading: 'One-time key display' body: 'This key will not be shown again. Download or copy it now.' CTA: 'Download key' secondary: 'I saved it'. small hint: 'Tip: use a secrets manager for long-term storage.'

Tom: mobile nit: overflow menu hits are tight. separate danger actions (Revoke, Rotate) into their own section with larger hit targets and a small lock icon for pinned keys. on mobile Revoke should require a confirm checkbox inside modal (reduce fat-fingers).

Jin: I prefer inline soft-revoke: row collapses to a pale banner 'Key revoked  undo' for 12s. keeps context and reduces modal churn. but ensure screen readers are notified: role="status" + aria-live="assertive" if revoke blocks traffic. otherwise polite.

Priya: bulk rotate flow: combined modal OK, but require explicit acknowledgment for >3 keys. suggestion: checkbox 'I understand this will invalidate the selected keys' + list of affected services. for >10 keys require typed confirm 'ROTATE'.

Accessibility-bot: automated check: focus-trap on drawer: WARN (needs fix); aria-live for copy: MISSING; color contrast on yellow callout hint: FAIL. Uploaded annotated artboard: https://design.redwood.local/file/one-time-key-v1-annotated

Maya: plan: I'll update prototype to anchored persistent panel, implement textarea focus, Copy aria-live, inline revoke banner with undo, and separate danger section in overflow. @Priya can you test mobile spacing? @Jin can you sanity-check the inline revoke announcement?

Tom: happy to test mobile spacing. will also review copy for clarity. :thumbsup:

Priya: will run a quick SR pass after the update.

Maya: will push v2 by EOD and link here.
